json.reply: Canisters, rations, the odd bit of salvage. I take chits, not stories. Though if you've got a story about why the moss is leaning, I might listen for free.
options: What do you have for sale?

json.reply: Thirty years on this deck. Moss doesn't lean. Not unless there's light on the other side of the hull. Don't repeat that where MATRON can hear.
